sources.title: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) Models for Robotics
sources.snippet: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models combine a camera feed and a natural language instruction into a single system that outputs robot motion, replacing separate perception and control pipelines. This architectural shift lets robots generalize to conditions they were not explicitly trained for, which scripted and classical control systems cannot do.
